name: THE BEAST
source:
THE BEAST is a role-playing horror furry visual novel about a world filled by terrifying monsters named "The Corrupted", a demonic species that hungers for human flesh and blood. A company of Alchemia Corp hired a special team called "BEAST Hunters" to hunt down and eliminate them. It was at this moment, Eric, a 17-year old boy who lives a smooth life without going out in a clean house, gradually learned that he is not a human...

[From [url=https://ghostrickfrost.itch.io/the-beast-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《THE BEAST》是一部毛茸茸的角色扮演恐怖视觉小说，讲述了一个充满可怕怪物的世界，名为“堕落者”，这是一种渴望人类血肉的恶魔物种。Alchemia公司的一家公司雇佣了一支名为“BEAST Hunters”的特别小组来追捕并消灭他们。就在这时，在干净的房子里，过着一帆风顺的生活的17岁男孩埃里克，逐渐发现自己不是人类……

[来自[url=https://ghostrickfrost.itch.io/the-beast-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
